name: Cross
description: ONEchain is a gaming-optimized Layer 1 blockchain designed to provide players with true ownership of in-game assets through a decentralized, EVM-compatible infrastructure. The network offers a modular development framework including SDKs, APIs, and smart contract templates to simplify blockchain integration for game studios. It features high-performance Byzantine Fault Tolerant (BFT) consensus capable of processing over 5,000 transactions per second with near-instant finality. The ecosystem includes native tools such as ONEpocket and a cross-chain bridge to BNB Smart Chain.
